name: Bend Battery
old_description: Bend Battery LLC is a leading provider of off-grid power solutions, specializing in Lithium
about:
Bend Battery LLC operates from Bend, Oregon, supplying off-grid power components and installation services for mobile and stationary applications. The company's founding date and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The business designs and installs complete energy storage systems centered on lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4) batteries, solar arrays, inverters, and charge controllers. It stocks and sells equipment from brands such as Victron Energy, Blue Sea Systems, Furrion, and Dicor, covering solar charge controllers, inverter/chargers, battery monitors, disconnect switches, and roof sealants. The team provides technical consulting to size systems for RVs, vans, trailers, boats, and off-grid homes, and performs the installation work themselves rather than subcontracting.

Customers include RV owners upgrading factory electrical systems, van-life builders, trailer owners, marine operators, and off-grid homeowners. Reviews cite projects like a 28-day off-grid trip in an Arctic Fox 27-5L trailer and ongoing supply for Channel Islands Charter, indicating both one-off upgrades and repeat commercial accounts.

Bend Battery emphasizes guided system design and post-sale support, with a policy of installing only systems they have specified. The company highlights a bundle builder that discounts multi-item orders and free shipping on orders over $49.99, positioning itself as a single source for both hardware and expertise.
